title: Standards of Admission to the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts
content:
Every product in the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range carries its own entry gate, and the gate is read against the profile that applies for it.

## 1. The standards

1.1 The parts of an entry gate are the kind of profile the product is written for, the least age in years, the kind of credit check, the trade references a business product requires, the months a profile must already have stood on an earlier Northbeam credit account where the product is a step-up, the annual turnover a product requires of a business, and, on the deferred interest product, a purchase present at the time of application. A product states only the parts that belong to it.

1.2 Identity documents are required on all six products in the range; none of them is opened without them.

1.3 Each product states the least age at which it may be opened, whether a second individual may be added as jointly liable, and the number of named buyers who may be authorised to draw on the account.

## 2. Entry gate as it stands on each product

| Product | Kind of profile | Least age in the gate | Credit check | Further gate conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | consumer | 18 | standard | none |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | consumer | 18 | standard | 6 months already stood on an earlier Northbeam credit account |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | consumer | 21 | prime | none |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | consumer | 18 | standard | a purchase present at the time of application |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | business | not stated in the gate | commercial | 2 trade references |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | business | not stated in the gate | commercial | 3 trade references and annual turnover of 1000000.00 US dollars |

## 3. Opening figures of each product

| Product | Least age at which the account may be opened | Identity documents | Second individual jointly liable | Authorised buyer places |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 18 | required | not allowed | 1 |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 18 | required | allowed | 2 |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 21 | required | allowed | 2 |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 18 | required | not allowed | 1 |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 18 | required | not allowed | 15 |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 18 | required | not allowed | 80 |

## 4. Notes on the standards

- The stated age is the least age at which the account may be opened, so a profile of exactly that age meets it. A consumer profile aged 19 meets the least age of the Northbeam Store Card, the Northbeam Store Card Plus and the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account, and does not meet the 21 of the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card.
- A business profile that has filed 2 trade references meets that condition of the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account and does not meet the 3 the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit requires.
- Only the Northbeam Store Card Plus states a months-already-stood condition, and only the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account requires a purchase present when the application is taken.
